purpose: Additional normal-acoustic check through the changed non-glancing outlet; the older y-normal pulse has zero normal background speed and tests the unchanged glancing branch.
initial_pulse: delta_rho=2e-5*exp(-0.5*((x-180)/10)^2), delta_ux=cs*delta_rho; same amplitude, width and probe distance as previous y test
comparison: Same pulse and UBB at both ends versus UBB inflow and prototype characteristic outlet. Same lattice collision/viscosity as all other diagnostics.
gate: reflected/incident amplitude <=0.1 and <=UBB ratio/5, exactly the previous acoustic acceptance threshold
scope: Small normal linear pulse; does not establish oblique-wave, corner or airfoil accuracy.
